Meta.homeTitle: Spotex International · Martial Arts Uniform Manufacturer
Meta.homeDescription: BJJ gis, judo uniforms, rash guards, MMA shorts, gi bags and belts, made in our own factory in Pakistan and custom-branded for academies and brands in the USA and Europe.

Common.quickNote: Made in our own factory. Your logo, colours and sizes on request, with a sample first.

Footer.tagline: Martial arts uniforms, woven, cut and stitched in our own factory in Gujranwala, Pakistan, since 1989.

Hero.copy: BJJ gis, judo uniforms, rash guards and MMA shorts, made in our own factory and branded for academies in the USA and Europe.

notes.pants: Ripstop pants: light, quick-drying and tear-resistant, with reinforced knees.

notes: BJJ gis in pearl, gold, all-play and honeycomb weaves, in every IBJJF-approved colour, with ripstop pants and your academy patches.
Single and double-weave judo uniforms from 450 to 750 GSM, in white, blue, black or pink.
Fully sublimated MMA and grappling shorts in stretch polyester, printed with your designs and team colours.
Sublimated gi bags and backpacks, branded for your academy.
Rank belts in every IBJJF colour, with rank bars and your embroidery.

factory.text: Every step happens in-house in Gujranwala, Pakistan.

HomeCta.text: Tell us what you need: uniforms, belts, rash guards or shorts, with or without your artwork.

design.name: Design & Development
design.text: Your artwork turned into production-ready designs and tech packs.
design.lead: Every order starts at the design desk. Our team turns your logo, colours and ideas into production-ready artwork, placement mock-ups and a tech pack the whole factory works from.
points: Logo clean-up and vector artwork
Placement mock-ups for every branding spot
Tech packs with measurements, materials and colours
design.benefit: You see exactly how the uniform will look before a single metre of fabric is cut.

pattern.name: Pattern Making
pattern.text: Patterns graded for every size, from kids to A5.
pattern.lead: Pattern makers turn the design into patterns graded for every size, from kids to adult A5, so the fit stays the same across the whole size range.
points: Patterns graded for kids and adult sizes
Fit adjusted for each discipline
Patterns kept on file for repeat orders
pattern.benefit: Re-orders fit exactly like your first batch.

fabric.name: Fabric Making
fabric.text: Pearl, gold, honeycomb and more weaves, made on our 30 looms.
fabric.lead: On our 30 looms we weave the fabrics that go into our gis: pearl, pearl plus, gold, all-play, honeycomb, diamond, chess, hemp and bamboo-cotton weaves, controlling weight and density from the very first thread.
points: Nine gi weaves, from pearl and gold to honeycomb and diamond
Jacket weights from 280 to 750 GSM
Pants in ripstop, cotton twill or baby canvas, 8 to 12 oz
Every roll checked for weight and shrinkage
fabric.benefit: The fabric in your sample is the fabric in your bulk order.

knitting.name: Knitting
knitting.text: Knitted fabrics for rash guards and MMA shorts.
knitting.lead: Stretch and knitted fabrics for rash guards and MMA shorts are made in-house on our knitting machines.
points: Stretch fabrics for rash guards and leggings
Fleece and training fabrics
Breathable mesh and linings
knitting.benefit: Rash guards, shorts and gis from one supplier, in matching colours.

dyeing.name: Fabric Dyeing
dyeing.text: Colours matched to your brand and dyed in-house.
dyeing.lead: Our dye house colours fabric to your brand colours, batch by batch, and checks every batch against the approved shade.
points: Colours matched to your brand
Every batch checked against the approved shade
Colour-fast dyes for frequent washing
dyeing.benefit: Your blue stays your blue, order after order.

cutting.name: Cutting
cutting.text: Precise cutting for consistent sizing across every order.
cutting.lead: Fabric is laid out and cut precisely to the graded patterns, so every jacket, pair of pants and short in a size comes out the same.
points: Precise cutting to graded patterns
Fabric laid out to keep waste low
Every bundle labelled by size
cutting.benefit: Consistent sizing across the whole order.

printing.name: Printing
printing.text: Embroidery, screen, DTF and digital print, and full sublimation.
printing.lead: Logos and artwork are applied in-house: embroidery, woven patches, screen printing, DTF printing, digital printing and full sublimation.
points: Embroidery and woven patches
Screen and DTF printing
Digital printing and full sublimation
printing.benefit: One factory handles your branding, so placement and colours match the mock-up.

stitching.name: Stitching
stitching.text: Reinforced seams built for hard training.
stitching.lead: Skilled operators assemble each uniform with reinforced seams and stress points, on 56 single-needle machines backed by three-needle, bartack, overlock and Kansai waistband machines.
points: 56 single-needle machines, plus three-needle, bartack, overlock and Kansai waistband machines
Reinforced seams and stress points
Double stitching where gis take the most strain
Labels and patches sewn in, never glued
stitching.benefit: Uniforms that survive years of grip fighting.

inspection.name: Inspection & Press
inspection.text: Every piece checked, pressed and measured.
inspection.lead: Every finished piece is checked, measured and pressed before packing, and our lab tests fabric and finished products.
points: Measurements checked against the size chart
Seams, branding and finish inspected
Pressed and folded, ready for retail
inspection.benefit: What arrives is exactly what you approved.

packing.name: Packing
packing.text: Packed with your labels, ready for export.
packing.lead: Orders are packed with your labels, hang tags and branded packaging, then prepared for export by air or sea.
points: Hang tags and branded bags
Packing lists by size and product
Export paperwork for the USA and Europe
packing.benefit: Ready to sell the day it reaches you.

bjj-gis.name: BJJ Uniforms
bjj-gis.intro: Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu gis from 280 to 550 GSM in pearl, gold, all-play, honeycomb and other weaves, with ripstop, cotton twill or canvas pants. Made to order in every IBJJF-approved colour, with your academy branding.

judo-uniforms.name: Judo Uniforms
judo-uniforms.intro: Judo gis in three weights: 450 GSM Academy, 550 GSM Challenger and 750 GSM Winner, with 100% cotton drill pants. In white, blue, black or pink.

belts.name: BJJ Belts
belts.intro: BJJ and judo rank belts, metal-loop belts, master belts, 13-row stitched belts, 350 GSM gi-fabric belts and casual belts, in every rank colour and in sizes S to 3XL.

mma-shorts.name: MMA Shorts
mma-shorts.intro: Fully sublimated MMA and grappling shorts in stretch polyester, printed with your designs and team colours.

rash-guards.name: Rash Guard
rash-guards.intro: Short and long sleeve rash guards in compression fabric, sublimated with your designs and rank colours.

bags.name: Gi Bags
bags.intro: Sublimated gi bags, gi backpacks, duffel bags and shoulder-strap bags, branded for your academy.

PrivateLabel.metaDescription: Launch your own BJJ gi or martial arts brand. Your design, your labels, made in our own factory.
PrivateLabel.intro: We make uniforms and gear for academies, clubs and brands under their own name. You bring the idea, we handle fabric, production and packing. Orders start from 30 pieces, and we make 12,000 to 15,000 uniforms a month.

steps.title: Share your idea
steps.text: Send your artwork, colours and the products you need.

steps.title: Design & sample
steps.text: We prepare the design and make a first sample, with or without your artwork, usually in 7 to 10 days.

steps.title: Approve
steps.text: You check the sample and we adjust until it is right.

steps.title: Production
steps.text: Your order is made in our own factory, from fabric to finishing. Lead time depends on the product and quantity, and we confirm it with your quote.

steps.title: Packing & shipping
steps.text: Packed with your labels and shipped to your door.

FactoryPage.metaDescription: Ten in-house departments, from fabric making and dyeing to stitching and packing. See how Spotex makes martial arts uniforms.
FactoryPage.intro: Most uniform suppliers buy fabric and outsource stitching. We do every step ourselves in Gujranwala, Pakistan, so we control quality, colour and delivery time. With 30 looms and more than 60 sewing machines we make 12,000 to 15,000 uniforms a month, and more for large orders.
FactoryPage.quality: Our R&D and apparel testing lab checks materials and finished products before they ship. Spotex is ISO 9001:2015 certified.
csr: A free IT training centre for local people and employees, with more than 1,000 graduates.
Free firefighting training and sports activities for the local community.

AboutPage.metaDescription: A martial arts uniform manufacturer in Gujranwala, Pakistan, making gis and belts since 1989.
AboutPage.intro: Spotex International started as a small workshop in Gujranwala, Pakistan. Today we make martial arts uniforms, belts and fight wear for academies, clubs and brands abroad, with every step of production under our own roof.

story.title: Where we started
story.text: Spotex began in 1989 as a small stitching workshop in Gujranwala, the heart of Pakistan’s sportswear industry.

story.title: What we built
story.text: Step by step we brought fabric making, dyeing, printing and quality testing in-house, so every uniform is made under one roof.

story.title: Where we are today
story.text: Today we make uniforms, belts and fight wear for academies, clubs and brands in the USA and across Europe.
